# Product Manager, Growth in California at Snout

Salary: $120000 - $200000 Employment Type: Full-Time

Snout California, United States Posted on July 10, 2026

## Job Description

🐶 Our mission

Every pet should get the care they need, regardless of cost. Vet med prices are up 40% since 2020, and pet owners are stuck having to pick between their bank account and furry friend. At Snout, we aim to solve this by enabling clinics to offer wellness plans that actually work.

🚀 The opportunity

Snout is one of the fastest growing wellness plan providers in the veterinary space, trusted by clinics across the U.S. We’re a small but mighty startup team of <50 employees. We’re on the lookout for an experienced and remote Product Manager, Growth based in the U.S. to help leverage martech tools and optimize Snout’s user experience through our website and portal to fuel growth.

💻 The role

As our Product Manager, Growth, you'll sit at the intersection of product, growth, marketing, and tooling. You will own the surfaces (vet portal, website) and some of the systems or internal tooling that drive clinic acquisition, pet parent enrollment, and lifecycle engagement. In this non-traditional PM role, you'll need to be someone who is a whiz with marketing, proficient in prototyping using modern AI-assisted tools and focussed on shipping fast. 

You will shape how clinics discover Snout, how pet parents enroll, and how both experience the product at every stage of their journey while using AI and data to make every touchpoint smarter over time. You will impact Snout's product experience and growth engine, ensuring that it operates as one unified system. This is a rare chance to define the product-growth function and build the systems behind it from the ground up.

If you're a strategist and an executor, we'd love to hear from you!

Snout is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We know that great candidates may not check every box — and that’s okay. If you're excited about this role and our mission, we encourage you to apply if you meet at least 75% of qualifications including the first bullet. If you need any accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’re happy to support you.

🛠 What you’ll do

- Own the Snout vet directory, portal and website as growth products: local SEO and clinic discovery, conversion optimization, ICP-segmented journeys, and A/B testing across hero messaging and enrollment paths
- Own the pet parent enrollment flow end to end: friction reduction, mobile UX, and conversion rate optimization
- Collaborate with various stakeholders on the clinic-facing experience: onboarding UX, plan-builder interface, dashboard utility — and define and measure the "first plan live" activation moment
- Build the in-product data layer and AI-powered experiences: personalization, behavioral triggers, smart nudges, predictive enrollment prompts, and automated clinic insights layered on top of Snout's core platform
- Define event instrumentation with engineering so clean data feeds both product analytics and lifecycle systems (Customer.io for pet owners, HubSpot for clinics), and translates usage into activation, churn, and expansion signals
- Run continuous experimentation across email and in-product touchpoints: onboarding sequences, usage nudges, expansion prompts, renewal flows

💡What we're looking for

- 5+ years of experience across product management, product-led growth, growth engineering and marketing
- Demonstrated experience managing or developing internal tooling (martech preferred) and leveraging AI-powered product features
- Proven track record of growth with a B2B2C, health tech, fintech, or marketplace/platform based product
- Strong technical fluency — you prototype in modern tools, write specs engineers love, and hold your own in data conversations.
- Experience with enrollment/onboarding optimization and lifecycle-stage thinking
- Comfort as both strategist and executor — you'll have a channel partner, but no large team so you’ll be hands-on
- Deep familiarity with product analytics and experimentation frameworks

🌟 What will make you stand out

- Prior founder or product marketing manager or general marketing experience
- Experience building directory or marketplace products for local discovery
- Fluency with AI-assisted development workflows (Cursor, Replit, v0) to ship growth experiments without waiting on eng sprints
- Comfort in Amplitude or Mixpanel, Figma or Framer, and Webflow or Sanity — you define what we measure and own the experimentation layer

💖 Why you should join Snout

- Fast growing, venture capital backed technology company focused on improving access to veterinary care
- Ability to have a meaningful impact from Day 1, where your voice and opinion matters
- Unlimited potential to grow in your career, learn and expand your skillsets
- Collaborative, flexible, and friendly culture

❌ Why this role might not be a fit for you

- You're not situated near a major airport or don't have the flexibility to travel on a quarterly basis
- The pace and uncertainty of startup life feels destabilizing rather than energizing
- You thrive within a fully established demand generation infrastructure rather than building one from the ground up
- You gravitate toward optimizing existing funnels rather than architecting new ones
- You haven't operated in a cross-functional setting alongside Sales or CX counterparts
- You don't have a connection to animals or an affinity for our mission

💸 Compensation

- $120 000 - $200 000 base salary
- Equity

⚕️ Benefits

- Day 1 medical/dental/vision benefits
- Flexible time off + 11 Snout calendar holidays
- Paid parental leave

The Role

The Head of Marketing will lead marketing campaigns targeting both veterinarians and pet owners, leveraging data-driven strategies to build brand visibility and drive growth.

Summary Generated by Built In

🐶 Our mission

Every pet should get the care they need, regardless of cost. Vet med prices are up 40% since 2020, and pet owners are stuck having to pick between their bank account and furry friend. At Snout, we aim to solve this by enabling clinics to offer wellness plans that actually work.

🚀 The opportunity

Snout is one of the fastest growing wellness plan providers in the veterinary space, trusted by clinics across the US. We’re a small but mighty startup team of <50 employees. We're searching for a data-driven and creative Head of Marketing to work closely with our CEO to build our marketing function from the ground up. This role is very multifaceted - you will lead the charge and define our veterinary facing brand, work with our hundreds of veterinary partners to market to millions of pet parents on a monthly basis, and drive the strategy behind consumer branding as well. This role is remote US based, with a strong preference for candidates in the New York City area.

💻 The role

Snout is a B2B2C company and our plans are sold exclusively through our veterinary partners. We're looking to hire someone who is a strategic "doer." Y ou will be in charge of both marketing to veterinarians and helping them market to their clients. The latter will be the first area of focus. The marketing team will work with our veterinary partners and their account managers to build and test campaigns, from emails to swag bags, it’s all fair game. We have millions of pet parents in our database and our vet partners are hungry for support. Once we find working paths, you’ll work with our product team to scale it out to all of our partners.

This role combines problem solving, creativity and experimentation with data-driven decision making. You’ll work with our engineering team to refine millions of records for your needs and insights. From there, you'll build outward: developing Snout's voice, visual identity, and go-to-market playbook. In this role, you’ll have freedom to play and test all your ideas. There is no shortage of experiments to run. When they don't, you'll learn fast and move on. We promise you won’t be bored!

If you’re scrappy Founding Marketer archetype, data-driven, and energized by the chance to build a brand that truly makes a difference, this is the role for you!

Snout is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We know that great candidates may not check every box — and that’s okay. If you're excited about this role and our mission, we encourage you to apply if you meet at least 75% of qualifications including the first bullet. If you need any accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’re happy to support you.

🛠 What you’ll do

- Create a strong and recognizable Snout brand narrative
- Design and run multi-channel acquisition campaigns (email, SEO, SEM, content, social) while creating compelling content that highlights our value
- Partner closely with our veterinary partners and account managers to refine ads, copy, messaging, and positioning based on performance and customer feedback
- Own marketing operations and budget: build and maintain the tech stack, set up attribution models, and create dashboards to track key metrics
- Drive growth experimentation by testing new channels, analyzing results, and scaling what works
- Build, coach and manage a team that successfully hits OKR goals

💡What we're looking for

- 5+ years of marketing experience, ideally as an early marketing hire (Founding Marketer) at a tech startup or incubator, and product or content marketing focus
- Comfort in analytics: using spreadsheets, analytics, sales, CRM and automation tools to test, measure, and scale what works
- A strong communicator and storyteller
- Prior hands-on experience with and a deep understanding of email (Mailchimp, etc.), digital campaigns (SEO, SEM), content, and partnerships to build brand visibility across many channels
- Ability to thrive in fast-moving environments where creativity meets data
- Track record of driving growth effectively and efficiently with scrappy, innovative marketing strategies in budget
- Problem-solver who leans on first principles to tackle challenges and organizer who takes ownership to lead projects end-to-end
- Open to occasional travel as needed

🌟 What will make you stand out

- Experience building, managing and developing high performing teams
- Experience managing contractors or freelancers to execute marketing plans
- Experience leading product marketing and GTM efforts, from defining positioning and messaging to launching new products and driving adoption alongside our executive team

💖 Why you should join Snout

- Fast growing, venture capital backed technology company focused on improving access to veterinary care
- Ability to have a meaningful impact from Day 1, where your voice and opinion matters
- Unlimited potential to grow in your career, learn and expand your skillsets
- Collaborative, flexible, and friendly culture

❌ Why this role might not be a fit for you

- You don’t have experience at a seed, Series A/B/C startup
- You are used to having a team run things for you and don’t want to be hands-on
- You aren’t confident performing data analysis using spreadsheets
- You don’t have a track record of managing a marketing budget effectively and efficiently
- You aren’t a pet or animal lover
- You don’t live close to an airport and have travel flexibility

💸 Compensation

- $150 000 - $250 000 base salary
- Equity

⚕️ Benefits

- Day 1 medical/dental/vision benefits
- Flexible time off + 11 Snout calendar holidays
- Paid parental leave

## Skills Required

- 5+ years of marketing experience
- Experience at a startup
- Comfort in analytics using spreadsheets and related tools
- Hands-on experience with digital campaigns
- Ability to thrive in fast-moving environments

The Company

 HQ: Petaling Jaya 

 43 Employees 

Year Founded: 2021

## What We Do

 Snout makes veterinary care accessible to all pet owners through instant, universal financing - with no credit checks, breed, or age restrictions. Pet owners enroll through their veterinarian and receive immediate coverage, while Snout pays the practice directly.

# Snout (Snout, Inc.)

Snout is a Veterinary Services company. Snout helps veterinary clinics offer affordable monthly pet wellness plans, making preventive care accessible and stress-free for pet owners. Snout employs 33 people (+76.7% YoY, +23 people), founded in 2021. Headquartered in Troy, Michigan, United States, with an office in San Francisco. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Poland, and Canada. Has $120.2M in total funding, with 8 prior funding rounds.

## About

Snout makes veterinary care accessible to all pet owners through instant, universal financing - with no credit checks, breed, or age restrictions. Pet owners enroll through their veterinarian and receive immediate coverage, while Snout pays the practice directly.

# We’re hiring a Head of Marketing at Snout!! | Nicholas Naclerio · LinkedIn · 2026-05-20

**Nicholas Naclerio**: Founder & CEO at Mmmly with 8 years 2 months of experience. Previous roles include Sous Chef for Executive Corporate Pastry Chef at Barton G. Based in New York City Metropolitan Area [US].

---

We’re hiring a Head of Marketing at [Snout](https://linkedin.com/company/snoutplans)!!

[Snout](https://linkedin.com/company/snoutplans) is one of the fastest growing wellness plan providers in the veterinary space.

Vet med costs are up 40% since 2020. Pet owners are being forced to choose between their bank account and their pet’s health. That’s a problem we’re hell-bent on fixing, and we need a great marketer to help us do it.

We work with clinics across the US to offer plans that actually work, and we have millions of pet parents in our database ready to be reached.

We’re looking for someone with 5+ years in marketing (ideally at an early-stage tech startup), who is equally comfortable in a spreadsheet and a brainstorm, and ready to build this function from the ground up reporting directly to our CEO.

A love for data is a huge plus.

Remote-friendly (NYC or metro Detroit preferred).

If this sounds like you or someone you know, apply here!!
